scope: Restore the missing review-fixes prerequisites and port every cumulative update through the final liquid-glass corrections into the Neo sister repository without changing its deployment topology or touching its running state.

sdd.limit: Document and manifest validation is separate from formal QA execution and release readiness.

repository.runtime_operation: No deployment, restart, provider probe, secret change or consultation interruption was performed.

source.mapping_rule: Reference behavior was adapted to Neo filenames, contracts and infrastructure; the reference repository was not copied as infrastructure.

baseline_verification.finding: The Neo target did not contain the claimed review-fixes baseline in full. The missing parallel consultation, request isolation, source persistence, recovery, usage and supporting test prerequisites were restored before the cumulative A-F updates were integrated.
restored_contracts: Head-planned parallel specialist execution with immutable Critic corrections and one final synthesis
accepted-request binding by internal message identity with legacy compatibility
request-scoped provider context and private provider workspaces

implementation_map.behavior: Port the final prompt and instruction defaults while preserving owner-edited database revisions through exact-default migrations.
Run independent Head assignments concurrently, preserve request identity, commit consultation work transactionally and retain safe stop/continue behavior.

implementation_map.category: Provider execution and private local state
implementation_map.behavior: Use bounded child processes, ephemeral provider sessions and private files without replacing the existing provider or authentication connections.
Reuse evidence for repeated gaps, persist attributable source records and expose complete per-response and account-level usage without fabricating unavailable provider fields.

implementation_map.category: Tables, native RTF, reading controls and Usage UI
implementation_map.behavior: Render safe Markdown tables, export real RTF tables, add current-panel reading controls and present privacy-safe attributed Usage details.
Apply the final curved-edge refraction fixes with stable content visibility, native-control exclusions, privacy-clear behavior and licensed fallback handling.
Cover baseline restoration, isolation, research, accounting, tables, recovery, browser integration and glass behavior with deterministic fixtures.
Bind the cumulative implementation and Neo-specific activation boundary to the repository-owned SDD chain.

preserved_topology.database: Existing private Northflank MySQL service with encrypted persisted private data
preserved_topology.authentication: Existing Google owner authentication and session behavior
preserved_topology.edge: Dedicated Cloudflare Worker nanoduck-neo with its existing shared-origin-key contract
preserved_topology.providers: Existing Codex and Claude provider connections and saved model/settings contract
preserved_topology.active_consultations: Untouched; no runtime action was taken during this implementation run

automated_tests.skip_reason: The four real-MySQL integration cases require an isolated disposable MySQL runtime, which was not present locally. They remain not_run at that seam; no named CI execution is claimed.

suites: safe Markdown tables at desktop and narrow widths
final liquid-glass geometry, fallback, no-flicker and privacy-clear behavior
integrated Neo reading, retry, Usage, authentication and privacy flows

diff_check.command: git diff --check against the exact implementation revision

workload_measurement.interpretation: The synthetic shared-evidence case stayed bounded. The repeated-gap fixture reused existing evidence after one research call and one query-planning call; this is not a live-provider cost guarantee.

native_rtf.observed: The synthetic exported document converted to an HTML table with Unicode text, escaped punctuation and source references; Word, LibreOffice and GUI-reader inspection were unavailable.

license_attribution.scope: The notice preserves MIT attribution for adapted source portions without applying that license to unrelated Neo files; the glass component also keeps an adjacent notice.

checks: No machine-specific absolute path was added to committed code, tests or documentation.
No provider grant, credential, shared origin key, private conversation, owner identifier or private record was added.
The reference input location is omitted; only repository-neutral provenance and its digest are retained.

limits: No live Codex or Claude benchmark or subscription probe was run.
No native Safari or physical-device verification is claimed; WebKit coverage is recorded separately.
No disposable local MySQL runtime was available, so the four authored real-MySQL cases remained skipped.
No Northflank or Cloudflare deployment, scale action, restart or hosted health check was performed.
Formal release readiness remains not_evaluated until formal QA, deployment activation and hosted continuity checks are complete.

activation.reason: The repository changes do not become active on the existing Northflank service until the owner chooses a safe runtime activation window.
required_sequence: Confirm there are zero active or recoverable consultation runs that would be interrupted.
Take and verify a current private-MySQL backup or provider snapshot.
Scale the existing Northflank application service to zero and confirm all containers have stopped.
Select or deploy the approved repository build while the service remains at zero, without replacing the database, Google authentication, provider grants or nanoduck-neo Worker topology.
Start exactly one application instance; src/server/start.mjs runs the repeat-safe schema and instruction-default migration before HTTP startup.
Verify health, private-MySQL TLS connectivity, Google owner authentication, Cloudflare origin-key enforcement, saved settings/conversations and rollback.
Verify one isolated non-private smoke flow, then return to the intended service scale only after the checks pass.

execution.environment: Local macOS checkout; synthetic isolated application storage; Playwright Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; no live provider or hosted-runtime operation
